cve_summary: The cdf_unpack_summary_info function in cdf.c in the Fileinfo component in PHP before 5.4.29 and 5.5.x before 5.5.13 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (performance degradation) by triggering many file_printf calls.
commit_message: Remove loop that kept reading the same offset (Jan Kaluza)
docstring:
Summary: This code fragment processes and defines structures related to CDF (Compound Document Format) properties and class IDs.  
Parameters: N/A  
Returns: N/A  
Logic: The first part of the code updates a structure `ssi` with values converted from another structure `si` using `CDF_TOLE2` and `CDF_TOLE4` macros. It initializes a count and a pointer to info, then attempts to read property information using `cdf_read_property_info`, returning -1 on failure. The second part defines a function `cdf_print_classid` that formats a `cdf_classid_t` structure into a string representation, using `snprintf` to write the formatted output into a provided buffer. The last part declares a static array of structures that map property codes to their corresponding names, which can be used for reference when handling CDF properties.
